metaDescription: Shop custom tri blend workwear for a soft, durable feel. Perfect for branded uniforms. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a workwear option that feels soft against the skin while holding up to daily wear. Unlike standard cotton or 100% polyester, tri blend resists shrinking and pilling, making it a smart choice for uniforms that need to look good shift after shift. It also takes screen printing and embroidery cleanly, so your logo stays sharp. Whether you are outfitting a retail team or a warehouse crew, custom tri blend workwear offers the balance of comfort and durability that keeps employees happy and your brand front and center.
